fabric-govern-analytics-data.Q: What is the 'Prep data for AI' feature used for in Power BI?
fabric-govern-analytics-data.A: The 'Prep data for AI' feature ensures a semantic model is ready for quality AI interactions by defining schemas, providing instructions, and associating visuals with trigger phrases.

fabric-govern-analytics-data.Q: What governance actions should be taken for a data agent answering executive questions about revenue?
fabric-govern-analytics-data.A: Ensure the source semantic model is certified, sensitivity-labeled, and thoroughly documented.

fabric-govern-analytics-data.Q: How does certifying semantic models and lakehouses improve Copilot responses?
fabric-govern-analytics-data.A: Certifying these assets directly improves the quality of Copilot responses by prioritizing trustworthy and well-documented data.

fabric-govern-analytics-data.Q: What governance practices are mentioned for managing data assets in Microsoft Fabric?
fabric-govern-analytics-data.A: Endorsement, documentation, and lineage analysis.

fabric-govern-analytics-data.Q: What tool in Microsoft Fabric helps monitor governance coverage across the data estate?

fabric-govern-analytics-data.Q: What is the purpose of lineage views and impact analysis in Microsoft Fabric?

introduction-end-analytics-use-microsoft.Q: What is the OneLake catalog used for in Microsoft Fabric?
introduction-end-analytics-use-microsoft.A: The OneLake catalog helps users find and access data sources within their organization.

introduction-end-analytics-use-microsoft.Q: What is the primary item type in the Fabric IQ workload?
introduction-end-analytics-use-microsoft.A: The ontology, which defines business concepts, relationships, and rules.

introduction-end-analytics-use-microsoft.Q: What does Microsoft Copilot in Fabric assist with?
introduction-end-analytics-use-microsoft.A: Copilot helps with tasks like code completion, data transformation guidance, and report generation across Fabric workloads.

introduction-end-analytics-use-microsoft.Q: What are Fabric data agents used for?
introduction-end-analytics-use-microsoft.A: Fabric data agents enable conversational interfaces where users can ask questions about organizational data in natural language.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What type of data do Real-Time Dashboards in Microsoft Fabric display?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: They display current data that refreshes automatically to show changing conditions.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What type of database do Real-Time Dashboards in Microsoft Fabric connect to?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: They connect to KQL databases in eventhouses.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: How do Real-Time Dashboards differ from traditional reports in Microsoft Fabric?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: Real-Time Dashboards refresh frequently to show current data, whereas traditional reports show historical snapshots.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What is a Real-Time Dashboard in Microsoft Fabric built on?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: Real-time streaming data sources.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What is required to create a Real-Time Dashboard in Microsoft Fabric?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: A source of real-time data, such as a KQL database in an eventhouse.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What are the two authorization options for data sources in a Real-Time Dashboard?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: Pass-through identity and Dashboard editor's identity.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What is a tile in the context of a Real-Time Dashboard?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: A tile is a component of the dashboard that displays a real-time data visualization.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What is the purpose of the KQL query in a dashboard tile?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: To query the underlying data source and retrieve the data to be visualized.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What does the example KQL query provided retrieve?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: The most recent observation within the last 30 minutes for each neighborhood, including details of available bikes and empty bike parking docks.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What can you do after creating a tile in a Real-Time Dashboard?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: Edit the tile to define a visual representation of the data, such as a chart or map.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What additional element can you add to a Real-Time Dashboard besides data tiles?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: Text tiles to provide additional information.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What feature allows users to filter data displayed in Real-Time Dashboards?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: Interactive parameters.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: How can you organize content in a Real-Time Dashboard?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: By using multiple pages to group related content.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What is the purpose of the auto refresh feature in Real-Time Dashboards?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: To automatically update dashboard data without manual reloading.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: How can parameter values be defined in Real-Time Dashboards?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: Parameter values can be based on specific text or the results of a query.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What is the syntax to reference a parameter in a tile query?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: Use the parameter's variable name with an underscore prefix, e.g., `_selected_neighbourhoods`.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What is a practical example of using a parameter in a dashboard query?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: Filtering data by a specific neighborhood using a parameter like `_selected_neighbourhoods` in the query.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What is the purpose of defining base queries in a dashboard?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: Base queries improve maintainability by avoiding duplication of logic across multiple tiles and providing a general set of records that can be referenced by tile-specific queries.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: How do you reference a base query in a tile-specific query?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: You reference a base query in a tile-specific query by using its variable name.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What is an example of a base query variable name?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: An example of a base query variable name is `_base_bike_data`.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What does the following base query do: `bikes | where ingestion_time() between (ago(30min) .. now()) | summarize latest_observation = arg_max(ingestion_time(), *) by Neighbourhood`?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: This query retrieves the latest observation for each neighborhood within the last 30 minutes.

create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.Q: What is the advantage of using a base query in a dashboard?
create-real-time-dashboards-microsoft-fa.A: The advantage is that it centralizes common logic, making it easier to maintain and update queries that are used across multiple tiles.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What is the purpose of Activator in Microsoft Fabric?
use-fabric-activator.A: Activator is Microsoft Fabric's event detection and rules engine within Real-Time Intelligence.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What are the two main components you configure in Activator?
use-fabric-activator.A: Rules to check for specific conditions and actions to execute when those conditions are met.

use-fabric-activator.Q: Give an example of an action that Activator can execute.
use-fabric-activator.A: Sending email alerts, posting Teams messages, starting Power Automate flows, or running Fabric notebooks.

use-fabric-activator.Q: Name a real-world scenario where Activator could be used in manufacturing.
use-fabric-activator.A: Automatically alerting maintenance teams when equipment temperatures exceed safe operating ranges.

use-fabric-activator.Q: How can Activator help in supply chain management?
use-fabric-activator.A: By notifying managers when shipments deviate from planned routes or experience unexpected delays.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What is a healthcare-related use case for Activator?
use-fabric-activator.A: Alerting staff when patient monitoring devices detect critical changes.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What are business objects in the context of Activator?
use-fabric-activator.A: Business objects represent the real-world entities you want to monitor, such as packages, devices, or customers.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What do properties represent in a business object?
use-fabric-activator.A: Properties represent the specific data attributes of a business object, such as Temperature, City, or HoursInTransit.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What is the purpose of events in Activator?
use-fabric-activator.A: Events contain the actual data values that flow in from your data sources and are used to update the properties of business objects.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What is the first step in creating objects from an eventstream in Activator?
use-fabric-activator.A: The first step is to configure Activator as a destination in the eventstream.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What is a unique identifier used for when creating objects in Activator?
use-fabric-activator.A: A unique identifier is used to distinguish and create separate objects for each entity, such as using PackageId for packages.

use-fabric-activator.Q: How does Activator handle new data in an eventstream?
use-fabric-activator.A: Activator updates existing object properties with new data, creates new objects for unique identifiers, and ensures property values reflect the most recent data.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What are some alternative alerting approaches supported by the Activator engine?
use-fabric-activator.A: Alternative alerting approaches include creating dashboard alerts, system event alerts, and query alerts from KQL Queryset results and visualizations.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What is the purpose of the Monitor section in the Activator interface?
use-fabric-activator.A: The Monitor section configures what data properties Activator watches, such as selecting an attribute and applying summarization.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What are the summarization options available in the Monitor section?
use-fabric-activator.A: The summarization options are Average, Minimum/Maximum, Count, and Total.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What is the difference between Window size and Step size in summarization?
use-fabric-activator.A: Window size determines how much historical data to include, while Step size determines how often to recalculate.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What does the Condition section in the Activator interface define?
use-fabric-activator.A: The Condition section defines the execution point, specifying when Activator should act based on detection approaches like threshold monitoring or change detection.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What are the detection approaches available in the Condition section?
use-fabric-activator.A: The detection approaches are Threshold monitoring, Change detection, Range monitoring, and Missing data.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What is the purpose of the Property filter section in the Activator interface?
use-fabric-activator.A: The Property filter section narrows down which events get evaluated by applying filters to specific event properties.

use-fabric-activator.Q: How many filters can you combine in the Property filter section?
use-fabric-activator.A: You can combine up to three filters in the Property filter section.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What are the four types of actions available in Activator?
use-fabric-activator.A: Email actions, Teams actions, Power Automate actions, and Fabric item actions.

use-fabric-activator.Q: When should you use Email actions in Activator?
use-fabric-activator.A: When the recipient needs comprehensive context or when an immediate response isn't critical.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What is the purpose of Teams actions in Activator?
use-fabric-activator.A: To send immediate messages to channels or individuals for quick responses and team coordination.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What is Power Automate used for in Activator actions?
use-fabric-activator.A: To execute multi-step business processes across different systems automatically.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What do Fabric item actions in Activator do?
use-fabric-activator.A: They execute data pipelines or notebooks for processing and analysis.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What is the purpose of the Microsoft Fabric Activator?
use-fabric-activator.A: The Microsoft Fabric Activator is used to monitor data and set up detection rules for automated responses.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What action does the Microsoft Fabric Activator perform when detection rules are triggered?
use-fabric-activator.A: It sends email alerts automatically.

use-fabric-activator.Q: What prerequisites are required to complete the Microsoft Fabric Activator exercise?
use-fabric-activator.A: A Microsoft Fabric trial is required to complete the exercise.
